[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

nodes.title: Meridian User Prompt
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the editing task.
<Video 2> is a rough render of the same scene from the new camera: the pixels of <Video 1> re-projected through a point cloud, so wherever it shows content its colours, framing and layout are correct, and its flat mid-grey areas are holes where the source camera saw nothing.

summary:
[video editing + viewpoint change] The target video shows exactly the same scene as <Video 1>, at exactly the same moments in time, filmed by the second camera that <Video 2> was rendered from. Every subject, every piece of clothing, the background, the lighting and the whole performance are the ones in <Video 1>; only the camera differs, so the same things are seen from a different angle and at a different distance. The target video is <Video 2> completed: its framing and everything it shows are kept, and its grey holes are filled with what belongs there.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (source video editing): fully_preserved - the subjects, their faces, hair, build and clothing, the background, the props and the lighting are the same objects seen from a new viewpoint, and the motion and its timing are frame for frame the motion of <Video 1>. Nothing is added, removed or restyled.
<Video 2> (layout reference): fully_preserved - the camera path, the framing and the placement of everything it shows are kept exactly; its grey holes are not content and are filled in so that they agree with <Video 1>, and its speckles and jagged edges are cleaned up.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] One continuous shot of the scene of <Video 1>, framed exactly as <Video 2> is, frame for frame. The subjects perform the motion of <Video 1> with the same timing, in the same place, under the same lighting. The camera moves exactly as the camera of <Video 2> does, and there is no cut.

overall_soundscape:
No music and no speech.

nodes.title: How To
widgets_values:
LMS & Crossview both require a video added as a guildline.

LMS:
Add source video to guideline.

Crossview:
Add source video as reference <Video 1>. Add camera path video to guideline. lora strength must be 1.0

Meridian:
Add source video as reference <Video 1>. Add camera path as reference <Video 2>.
Important: VideoShift:3 AudioShift:3 (with THEIR turbo, won't work combined with any additional turbo) euler/simple, 3 steps

nodes.title: Final Prompt Output
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman whose appearance and motion are taken from <Video 1> and whose first-frame composition is anchored by <Picture 1>. <Picture 2> is the anatomy reference for <Subject 1>. <Audio 1> is the audio reference for the final track.

summary:
video editing. The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The woman <Subject 1> is redressed as a Pikachu costume and the original audio is kept identical.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (source video and camera): partially_preserved - the framing, background, lighting, and temporal structure are retained from the source and the shot begins from <Picture 1> as an opening anchor
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - the complete final audio track is <Audio 1> with no additions, replacements or remixes
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the identity and motion are from <Video 1> / <Picture 1> with the costume changed to Pikachu
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the first frame composition is the starting anchor for the edit
<Picture 2>: weak_reference - anatomy reference for <Subject 1> with no new visible anatomy shown

detailed_description:
The edit uses a vertical retail-store look with bright interior lighting and a shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1> and holds the same medium close framing as <Video 1>. <Subject 1> stands in the GameStop aisle with the red shelving, black wall, Pokémon plushies, “FIND YOUR COLOUR” sign and the “@GAMESTOP” Instagram watermark in the lower left preserved. <Subject 1> is now wearing a full Pikachu costume: oversized yellow hood with black-tipped ears, cheek circles, tail, and a Pikachu-printed polo that replaces the black GameStop polo. The PSA graded Pokémon card is still held in both hands at chest height. The costume covers the torso and legs completely and the body position, hand placement, rings, bracelets and necklace remain identical to the source. The camera remains static on a tripod with the same eye-level composition as <Video 1>. Over five seconds the woman gives a small smile and holds the card steady, with no additional action, cuts or camera moves. The audio is <Audio 1> throughout.

# --- Input Variables ---
loras_input = a
time_input = b

# --- 1. Lora Logic ---
# Get active lora names, strip path/extension, replace '_' and '-' with spaces, and pair with strength
loras_list = [l['name'].split('\\')[-1].rsplit('.', 1)[0].replace('_', ' ').replace('-', ' ') + ': ' + str(l['strength_model']) for l in loras_input if l['enabled']] if loras_input else []

# --- 2. Time Logic ---

# --- 3. Combined Output ---
lora_text + "\n" + time_text + "\n"
